In denoting the indirect object, which is not an animal, of the verb मन्य 'to think', the Dative -- 4th case is optionally used, when contempt is to be shown.

Terms: विभक्ति-4

In the मन्त्र portion of the Vedas there is लुक् elision of the sign of the Aorist (& लिट् -Perfect Tense) after the verbs घस् 'to eat', हूर् 'to be crooked', णश् 'to destroy', वृ 'to choose, to cover', दह् 'to burn', verbs ending in long आ , वृच् 'to avoid', कृ 'to make', गमि 'to go' and जनि 'to be produced'.

Terms: सिच्-elision
The affix सन् comes after the verbs मान 'to honour', बध् 'to bind', दान् 'to cut', and शान् 'to whet', and long ई is the substitute of इ -- सन्यतः

In the मन्त्र literature,the affix णिवन् comes after the words 1. श्वेतवह 2.उक्थश 3. पुरोडाश् ।

Terms: णिवन्

The affix णिनि comes after the verb मन् 'to think' when there is a word with a case-affix in composition with it.

Terms: णिनि

The affix ङीप् is not used after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending in the syllable मन्।

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्

In the मन्त्र literature, क्तिन् acutely accented comes after the following roots, forming words in feminine gender, denoting a 'mere action' 1. वृष् 'to rain' 2. इष् 'to wish 3. पच् 'to cook' 4. मन् 'to think' 5. विद् 'to know' 6. भू 'to be' 7. वि 'to go, to consume' 8. रा 'to give'.

Terms: क्तिन्

In forming the feminine with the affix ङीप् , औ is optionally the substitute of the final मनु (as well as the उदात्त ऐ).

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्

The affixes अञ् and यत् come after the word मनु and the augment षुक् is added when these affixes follow provided that the whole word so formed denotes a जाति (class name).

Terms: अञ् and यत्

The affix वुञ् comes after the words कच्छ etc. in the senses of born etc. when the meaning is 'a man' or 'what exists in a man'.

Terms: वुञ्

The affix वय comes in the sense of 'product' after the word द्रु , the word meaning 'a measure'.

Terms: वय

After the words 1. षष्ठ and 2. अष्ठम there may come respectively कन् (क) and लुक् elision of the affix when the meaning is a division of a measure called मान or grain or the part of the body of a beast respectively.

Terms: कन् (क)

The words ending in मन् or क्तिन् affixes and the words 1. व्याख्यान 2. शयन 3. आसन 4. स्थान and 5. क्रीत as well as याजक etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when at the end of a compound preceded by कारक word.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

After मनस् when the compound is a Name, the Instrumental -3rd case endings are not elided before the second member.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision

उद is optionally substituted for उदक before 1. मन्थ 2. ओदन 3. सक्तु 4. बिन्दु 5. वज्र 5. भार 6. हार 7. वीवध and 8. गाह।

Terms: Some Substitution

In a मन्त्र the final vowels of 1. सोम 2. अश्व 3. इन्द्रिय and 4. विश्वदेव्य are lengthened when the affix मतुप् follows.

Terms: संहिता Lengthening

In the मन्त्र-s , the beginning of आत्मन् is elided when the affix of the Instrumental -3rd case singular follows.

Terms: आ elision
